## 3. Sprint 21 Activation & Multi-Agent Coordination (Options Volatility Dispersion & Skew Hedging Engine)

### 3.1 Sprint 21 Scope & Mathematical Architecture
Sprint 21 delivers an institutional-grade **Real-Time Options Volatility Dispersion & Multi-Expiry Skew Hedging Engine**, expanding TradeCraft AI's volatility quantitative trading desk:
- **Implied Correlation & Dispersion Spread:** Solving the non-linear relationship between NIFTY 50 Index Implied Volatility and constituent stock implied volatilities:
  $$\sigma_{\text{index}}^2 = \sum_{i=1}^n w_i^2 \sigma_i^2 + 2 \sum_{i < j} w_i w_j \rho_{ij} \sigma_i \sigma_j$$
  $$\bar{\rho}_{\text{impl}} = \frac{\sigma_{\text{index}}^2 - \sum w_i^2 \sigma_i^2}{\left(\sum w_i \sigma_i\right)^2 - \sum w_i^2 \sigma_i^2}, \quad S_{\text{disp}} = \sum w_i \sigma_i - \sigma_{\text{index}}$$
- **Multi-Expiry Volatility Skew:** Modeling near-week, next-week, and monthly expiry smiles, extracting 25-Delta Risk Reversal ($\text{RR}_{25\Delta}$) and Butterfly ($\text{Fly}_{25\Delta}$) skew metrics.
- **Delta-Neutral & Vega-Neutral Rebalancing:** Calculating optimal constituent hedging weights and automated cash/futures offsetting positions.
- **Dynamic Gamma Scalping Simulator:** Simulating underlying path shocks, rebalancing threshold breaches ($\pm \Delta_{\text{thresh}}$), and net P&L decomposition (Gamma gains vs Theta drag and SEBI statutory friction).
